`UnifiedActivationPipeline` (`.aios-core/development/scripts/unified-activation-pipeline.js`) is the entry point for all 12 agents; `generate-greeting.js` delegates to `UnifiedActivationPipeline.activate(agentId)`. Pipeline: Phase 1 parallel 5 loaders (`Promise.all`); Phase 2 agent def; Phase 3 preference/session/workflow; Phase 4 enriched context; Phase 5 `GreetingBuilder`. `loadUserProfile()` in `buildGreeting()` feeds `_buildContextualGreeting()`; preference accepts optional profile. PM bypasses bob restriction; bob non-PM `auto` redirects, `named` greets; bob non-PM commands are empty. `*yolo` is universal.

Commands: 8 agents have visibility arrays; `qa`, `data-engineer`, `devops`, `ux-design-expert` fall back to first 12; `aios-master` uses `visibility: full`. Formats: structured (`name: xxx`) vs compact (`key: 'value'`); compact agents: qa, devops, data-engineer, ux-design-expert. Match existing format. Source `.aios-core/development/agents/`; Claude mirror `.claude/commands/AIOS/agents/`; separate files, `ideSync` syncs separately.

Mock `resolveConfig()` with `mockReturnValue` if called multiple times. `validate-user-profile.js` `validateUserProfile()` is pure. Always mock `fs`, `js-yaml`, `config-resolver`, and dependency modules BEFORE requiring the module under test. L1-L5 merge; L5 `user-config.yaml` wins. `user_profile` is USER_FIELD; `toggleUserProfile()` flips bob/advanced.

Permissions: `.aios-core/core/permissions/`; `cycleMode()`/`enforcePermission()` wired in `index.js`; `PermissionMode.MODE_CYCLE`: explore(0)->ask(1)->auto(2). Badge: `_safeGetPermissionBadge()`.

Greeting builders accept optional `sectionContext`; contextual greeting passes it to all. Present uses named brief greeting for existing/workflow; absent context falls back archetypal. `_safeBuildSection(fn)` uses SECTION_TIMEOUT (150ms), try/catch. Context/workflow sections paralleli
